mapper.select: SELECT s.*, b.project_id, v.version_no FROM billing_statements s JOIN billing_bases b ON s.base_id = b.base_id LEFT JOIN billing_base_versions v ON s.version_id = v.version_id WHERE s.statement_id = #{statementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_statements (base_id, version_id, billing_month, tax_rate, status, created_by) VALUES (#{baseId}, #{versionId}, #{billingMonth}, #{taxRate}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_statements SET status = #{status}, issued_date = #{issuedDate}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE statement_id = #{statementId}
UPDATE billing_statements SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE statement_id = #{statementId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_statement_items WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, statement_item_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_statement_items (statement_id, building, item_name, unit, base_quantity, excluded_quantity, excluded_reason, adjustment_quantity, adjustment_reason, unit_price, display_order, is_temporary, work_type, work_date, temporary_reason, markup_rate, policy_agreed, extra_work_id) VALUES (#{statementId}, #{building}, #{itemName}, #{unit}, #{baseQuantity}, #{excludedQuantity}, #{excludedReason}, #{adjustmentQuantity}, #{adjustmentReason}, #{unitPrice}, #{displayOrder}, COALESCE(#{isTemporary}, 0), #{workType}, #{workDate}, #{temporaryReason}, #{markupRate}, #{policyAgreed}, #{extraWorkId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM billing_statement_items WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} AND is_temporary = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_statement_other_items WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, statement_other_item_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_statement_other_items (statement_id, fee_name, quantity, unit_price, is_variable, display_order) VALUES (#{statementId}, #{feeName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{isVariable}, #{displayOrder})
